item.text: {"brief":"The user wants the cheapest round-trip flights from New York to London. They gave February 1 as the departure date and March 2 as the return date and explicitly said the dates are flexible, without specifying how much flexibility. They initially described travel as “next month”; the year and its consistency with the later dates remain unresolved. In response to the assistant’s questions, the user specified Air China, business class, and a direct flight. Specific New York and London airports were not provided. No flight options or prices have been presented."}
